description: MANAGEMENT data class. Discover the existing ACTIVE budget for each requested Entity and fiscal year, including earlier fiscal years. Newer independent drafts and archived versions are not readable. If there is no ACTIVE budget, the native list is empty; never substitute a draft or archived row. Budget ids and versions are source citations without identity fields. Locked FX rate and all money-valued fields are decimal strings. Filter fiscal-year start before paging. The signed page_token is pinned to the complete ACTIVE source; if source_changed, discard partial results and restart discovery at page 1 without the old token. This lists budget headers only, not cells, approval identities, or a recalculated budget.

page_token.description: Signed continuation from the prior page; restart without it if source_changed.

name: list_budgets
title: List budgets
